owner.name: Cypher Monkey
owner.bio: Cypher Monkey (@Cypher0x9) is a lifelong student and an AI builder. He comes from systems, networking, voice, and contact center work, and is moving into AI omni-channel agents. He learns in the open and shares what he learns so the next curious person has a head start.

path.tip: Levels are starter, explorer, navigator. Not a required order. Ask me to "build a path".
path.title: Learning path
path.text: From fundamentals to advanced. 1) Fundamentals (starter): SIP Universe, Python Lab, BA Lab. 2) Platform practice (explorer): Amazon Connect, Five9, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, Zoom/Talkdesk/Avaya, Microsoft Voice, CPaaS, AI Lab. 3) Advanced (navigator): Unified Communications Lab and Webex Lab. Levels describe the campus; they are not a certificate or a required order.
